reviews.title: Gawfolk 27" 2K Computer Monitor
reviews.comment: Wow, this is a decent monitor so far! It's better than decent even. I love that it has dual HDMI and Dual display port connections! I also love how clean the front of the monitor looks in terms of buttons and bezel, of which there are none of the former, and a slight bezel frame. The buttons of the monitor are on the back right-hand side if you are facing the display. They are easily reached and easy to press. The overall aesthetic is sleek and modern. The display's quality is excellent! There is zero ghosting, and the semi-matte finish reduces glare to virtually non-existant. The resolution, color depth & reproduction, sharpness, and contrast ratio are all absolutely excellent. It supports HDR on my Windows 11 Pro machine and looks absolutely stunning when compared to my old Dell flat panel monitor that I bought back in 2009. This monitor is like going from an old brick-style Nokia cellphone to an iPhone 17 or the newest Samsung. All I can really say is that this monitor looks much better than the price-point might suggest. Although I don't do much gaming other than GTA V, I can say that this monitor may not have every little feature available, but for the price, it has all of your basic gaming needs covered.

reviews.title: Amazing monitor.
reviews.comment: Just wow. This monitor is so good. I am pretty impressed of how well this performs. It's my first time using a 180hz monitor, so i am not that experienced on using high refresh rate monitors that much. At first, i was somehow scared, due to some reviews stating some negative things of this monitor, but i still decided to give it a try. At first, i connected the Display Port cable to my GPU. I was LAGGY as hell. Even when my pc was idle, i could barely move my mouse because of its lag, like a game running at 5 fps. So, i swapped cables, connected the HDMI and it worked flawlessly, though the maximum refresh rate i can use the monitor at is 144 hz. It still looks so smooth and good. I tried games like Black Ops 2, Gears of War Reloaded, Killing Floor 2, Call of Duty Black Ops 3; and WOW, they look SO SO smooth. I was used to play at 75 hz max, but now playing these games in ultra a 144hz feels like another level. I still wanna figure out what's up with the horrible stutter and lag when using display port. Not sure if it's the cable or my GPU. Overall the monitor works perfect. My rig is: Gigabyte Aourus B450M Corsair Vengeance 32 GB (2x16) AMD Ryzen 7 5700X Gigabyte RTX 3060 ti windforce. 800W PSU gold (i don't remember the brand) If any of ya'll can provide feedback on my issue when using the Display Port Cable, please let me know!

reviews.title: Screen cuts out randomly and major ghosting when it cuts back on.
reviews.comment: Alright this is my honest review. When I received the monitor everything looked fine. I wouldn’t say it’s a curved monitor, it looks more like a regular flat screen monitor. The speakers worked fine, but they lack bass. The colors are decent, I would say the whites are a bit bright and washed out in my opinion. But it’s not bad for the money. It was easy to set up and connect. The stand is sturdy enough to get the job done, and All the buttons worked. I didn’t see any issues with the monitor. Unfortunately 2 days into use and it keeps cutting to a black screen when I’m playing. I thought maybe it was the HDMI cord it came with so I bought a new HDMI and display port, but the issue persist and it Cuts on and off to a black screen, sometimes for 3-4 seconds than cuts back on. When it does come back on you see major ghosting on the monitor screen. Sometimes the black screen is fast like a second and sometimes it’s much longer 3-4 seconds. I heard this brand was pretty good, So I thought I would give them a try. So it’s a little unfortunate. I don’t think the screen should be cutting in and out only 2 days old. I thought I should just make you guys aware.
